_comment: Map layer registry. kind: boundary (staged boundary file), reference (source-built GeoJSON file), events / entities (database records filtered by type), imagery / analysis (satellite archive), planned (not implemented yet - shown honestly as unavailable). 'color' is a hint for the map style.

layers.name: India boundary
layers.description: Country polygon, Natural Earth (India point of view).

layers.name: Maritime boundary (EEZ)
layers.description: 200 NM Exclusive Economic Zone, Marine Regions.

layers.name: States / UTs
layers.description: State and union territory boundaries, geoBoundaries / DataMeet.

layers.name: Districts
layers.description: District boundaries (2021), geoBoundaries.

layers.name: Major cities
layers.description: Populated places, Natural Earth.

layers.name: Rivers
layers.description: Major rivers, Natural Earth 1:10m (generalised).

layers.name: NIT Raipur study area
layers.description: NIT Raipur pilot study area. PROVISIONAL (search area around Raipur's gazetteer point) until a verified campus boundary is supplied.

layers.name: Lakes / reservoirs
layers.description: Major lakes and reservoirs, Natural Earth 1:10m.

layers.name: Imagery AOIs
layers.description: Areas of interest with staged Sentinel-2 observations.

layers.name: Sentinel-2 true colour (AOI)
layers.description: Staged Sentinel-2 Level-2A image over each AOI (latest usable scene, or the date chosen in the Imagery drawer).

layers.name: Sentinel-1 SAR
layers.description: Radar imagery. Not staged in this build.

layers.name: Landsat
layers.description: Not staged in this build.

layers.name: Aircraft
layers.description: Latest ADS-B positions from OpenSky (incomplete coverage).

layers.name: Airports
layers.description: Airports in India, OurAirports.

layers.name: Flight activity
layers.description: Track history and density. Not implemented.

layers.name: Aviation alerts / NOTAM
layers.description: No openly licensed NOTAM feed integrated yet.

layers.name: Vessels (AIS)
layers.description: Requires an aisstream.io key and a streaming client. Not implemented.

layers.name: Ports
layers.description: Major ports, Natural Earth.

layers.name: Maritime events
layers.description: Not implemented.

layers.name: Current weather (cities)
layers.description: Model analysis at the 40 largest cities, Open-Meteo.

layers.name: Storms / cyclones
layers.description: GDACS tropical cyclones and EONET severe storms.

layers.name: Radar / rain
layers.description: No openly licensed India radar mosaic integrated yet.

layers.name: Weather alerts
layers.description: Not implemented.

layers.name: Earthquakes
layers.description: USGS catalogue, GDACS and EONET.

layers.name: Floods
layers.description: GDACS and EONET flood events.

layers.name: Landslides
layers.description: EONET landslide events.

layers.name: Other disaster alerts
layers.description: Other GDACS / EONET events.

layers.name: Fires
layers.description: NASA FIRMS detections (key required) and EONET wildfires.

layers.name: Drought
layers.description: GDACS / EONET drought events.

layers.name: Air quality
layers.description: OpenAQ requires an API key. Not implemented.

layers.name: Land cover
layers.description: Not staged.

layers.name: Protected areas
layers.description: WDPA terms require acceptance before download. Not staged.

layers.name: Major roads
layers.description: Natural Earth 1:10m major roads (generalised).

layers.name: Railways
layers.description: Natural Earth 1:10m railways (generalised).

layers.name: Power plants
layers.description: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3 (2021).

layers.name: Bridges
layers.description: Not staged.

layers.name: Industrial sites
layers.description: Not staged.

layers.name: Launches
layers.description: Launch Library 2, Indian launch sites.

layers.name: Space weather (Kp)
layers.description: NOAA SWPC planetary K-index (global, timeline only).

layers.name: Satellites overhead
layers.description: Earth-observation, weather and station satellites over India at the last refresh (computed from CelesTrak elements).

layers.name: Satellite passes over AOI
layers.description: Pass prediction not implemented yet.

layers.name: Internet outages
layers.description: IODA country-level signals for India (timeline only, no location).

layers.name: Network events
layers.description: Not implemented.

layers.name: News / public events
layers.description: No news/event feed integrated yet.

layers.name: Change events
layers.description: Accepted change candidates from the AOI change engine.

layers.name: Suppressed candidates
layers.description: Candidates rejected by false-alarm gates, with reasons.

layers.name: Discovery cluster
layers.description: Member places of one embedding-based discovery cluster (chosen from a chip or the Imagery drawer). A grouping by RemoteCLIP similarity, not a semantic class.

layers.name: ML change candidates
layers.description: MODEL-GENERATED CANDIDATE CHANGES from the BTC-B network (OSCD checkpoint) for analyst-chosen scene pairs. Not verified; separate from the rule-based change events.

layers.name: Watchlists
layers.description: Not implemented.
